summary: Iteration 10 backend + frontend verification. Backend 16/16 pytest (test_iteration10_analyze.py, 60s): all four /api/analyze combinations (1 img, 1 img + history, 2 imgs + viewLabels, 2 imgs + viewLabels + history) return 200 with valid JSON shape including new fields assessmentPossible/moreInfoNeeded/redFlags. Prompt-adaptation unit tests pass: single-photo wording present for n=1, 'SAME lesion' + 'Integrate information across all images' + view labels for n>1, 'Integrate the supplied clinical history' when history is non-empty, and 'No clinical history was provided.' otherwise. Validation: 0 images -> 422, 7 images -> 422, no auth -> 401. Regressions ok: /api/auth/login 200, /api/auth/me 200, /api/device/status 200, /api/activation-tool 200 (contains 'Offline Activation Generator'), /api/report/pdf 200 returning real PDF (starts with %PDF, content-type application/pdf). Frontend on 390x844 mobile viewport: login -> Home (trial-banner shown, never stuck on bootstrap-screen). new-scan-fab -> /assessment renders mode-quick + mode-enhanced with the spec copy. quick-upload-photo -> /capture?mode=quick&action=upload; file-chooser accepts a 800x800 JPEG and the review step renders with improve-title 'Want to improve the assessment?', history-summary 'No symptoms or history yet', analyze-btn 'Skip & Analyze', 1 photo thumbnail. add-history opens clinical-history-sheet (all 6 fields present); history-skip closes without changing summary; filling location+duration and pressing history-save updates the summary to '2 history details added' and analyze-btn label to 'Analyze Now'. Enhanced flow via upload-gallery-alt on /capture?mode=enhanced accepts 2 files, shows thumbnails with view labels 'Main / front view' + 'Left-angle view', analyze-btn 'Analyze Now'. On-device quality gate: adding a 100x100 JPEG via add-more-upload renders capture-error 'That photo is too small to assess. Please retake it closer to the lesion.' and the thumbnail count stays at 2 (image NOT added). History seeded via localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', <DOUBLE-JSON>) DOES reach the app after a hard reload (Home shows history-item-seeded-*). BUG FOUND: on that seeded case the /result page crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading resolution)' because app/result.tsx line 103 unconditionally reads item.imageInfo.resolution — that blocks the reanalyze-history + reanalyze-photos flow being verified end-to-end (see rca_of_issue). This is only reachable via seeded/legacy data since capture.tsx always writes imageInfo on new saves, but it will still red-screen any legacy analysis stored before the field existed. No Expo/React-Native deprecated-package usage found in the touched surfaces (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports).

ui_bugs.issue: Line 103 renders item.imageInfo.resolution without a null-check. Any HistoryItem whose imageInfo is missing (legacy scans stored before this field existed, or a case restored by reanalyze-photos/reanalyze-history before the new imageInfo is written) triggers a red-screen: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading \'resolution\')'. Fix: `item.imageInfo?.resolution ?? '—'` (or hide the pill entirely when missing). Reference: /app/frontend/app/result.tsx:103

integration_issues.flow: reanalyze-history / reanalyze-photos with seeded case (legacy analysis without imageInfo)
integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify end-to-end because /result crashes before the more-info-card CTAs are reachable on such items. New-user path (capture writes imageInfo) is unaffected.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _build_analysis_prompt correctly branches on len(images): single-photo wording for n=1, 'SAME lesion' + 'Integrate information across all images' for n>1, view labels joined in when supplied, history section only rendered when at least one field has non-empty trimmed value, otherwise 'No clinical history was provided.' Verified by direct import in pytest.

server.py /api/analyze setdefaults for assessmentPossible=True, moreInfoNeeded=[], redFlags=[] guarantee the new response fields exist even if Gemini omits them — confirmed by real-Gemini calls returning all 3 keys as proper types (bool + list + list).
AnalyzeIn uses Field(min_length=1, max_length=6) on images so 0-image and 7-image payloads are correctly rejected at the validation layer (422). Verified.

result.tsx currently mixes required and legacy fields — d.imageQuality.score/feedback, d.mostLikelyDiagnosis.*, d.redFlags, d.moreInfoNeeded are safe, but item.imageInfo.resolution is not defensive (see bug above).
seed_data_creation: None persisted server-side. Frontend seed pattern: localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify([historyItem]))) — the outer stringify is required because src/utils/storage/index.web.ts wraps every value in JSON.stringify and readHistory does a second JSON.parse.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Backend pytest for iteration 10 lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_analyze.py — 16 tests, ~60s (real Gemini calls x4). Safe to rerun. 2) /result?id=<id> currently red-screens for HistoryItems whose imageInfo is undefined — after the fix, seed a case using: inner=JSON.stringify([item]); outer=JSON.stringify(inner); localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', outer); then hard-reload. The item must include a real imageInfo object even after the fix if you want the quality pill to show something. 3) The Enhanced route (start-enhanced) does NOT auto-open the file picker on web — only quick-upload-photo (which has action=upload) does. To trigger the enhanced picker use page.expect_file_chooser + click('[data-testid="upload-gallery-alt"]'). 4) React-Native TextInputs are wrapped by a div with the testID; you must use `[data-testid="..."] input` selectors to fill them. 5) Quality gate rejects images <300px per side OR under ~9KB JPEG bytes — use random-noise JPEGs for valid tests (a solid-color 600x600 JPEG at quality 85 is only ~6KB and will be rejected by the byte threshold). 6) Login credentials unchanged: test1@example.com / secret123.
rca_of_issue: Bug: /result red-screens with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'resolution')`. Repro: (a) login as test1@example.com; (b) evaluate localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', <double-JSON of an array containing a HistoryItem without an imageInfo field>); (c) hard reload; (d) navigate to /result?id=<that id>. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/result.tsx line 103 renders `{item.imageInfo.resolution}` inside the quality pill row without an optional chain or fallback, so any HistoryItem missing imageInfo throws. Any pre-iteration-10 saved analysis (or a case restored via reanalyze-history/reanalyze-photos before the new imageInfo write completes) is exposed. Mitigation: replace with `{item.imageInfo?.resolution ?? '—'}` (or conditionally render the whole line). New-scan path is unaffected because capture.tsx always writes imageInfo when persisting.
